name: eQTL Catalogue

version.value: Release 7 and pre-release r8_beta (FTP directory dated 2026-01-28); home page cites 32 published studies

scope: Uniformly processed gene-expression and splicing QTL summary statistics and SuSiE fine-mapped credible sets from public human studies.

quantitative.summary: Beta, SE, p-value, PIP and credible-set membership.
quantitative.units: SD of normalised expression per allele

licence.name: Not confirmed: a License page is linked from the site but its text was not retrieved
licence.redistribution: Treat as open with citation until read

coverage_limitations: REST API v2 and v3 endpoints return HTTP 410 (retired); access is via FTP only
known_omissions: Metadata tables are hosted in a GitHub repository outside this session scope

reuse_decision.rationale: Open Targets already consumes eQTL Catalogue credible sets for colocalisation; defer direct download of the very large sumstats until a locus-level analysis requires them.
